verdict.rationale: Deploying agents to a managed runtime is a fair question for an agent framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents local execution through Runner.run/run_sync/run_streamed, sandbox workspaces, and tracing, with no first-party managed hosting or API-endpoint deployment. The Temporal durability mention is a user-side integration, and sandbox agents are isolated execution workspaces rather than a hosted deployment endpoint.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint
